DSize.text: Makes a size from a width and a height.

DRect.text: Makes a rectangle from its edges.

DRectWidth.text: Width of a rectangle (right minus left; negative if it is not normalised).

DRectHeight.text: Height of a rectangle (bottom minus top; negative if it is not normalised).

DRectNormalized.text: Swaps edges where needed so left is not greater than right and top is not greater than bottom.

DRectContains.text: Whether a point lies inside or on the edge of a rectangle (normalised first).
DRectContains.returns: True if the point is inside

PointsClose.text: TinyCAD's point equality: both coordinates within 0.001. The C++ operator== on CDPoint.
PointsClose.returns: True if the points count as the same point

LineDistanceMode.text: Distance from a point to a line segment (a port of CLineUtils): horizontal and vertical lines, diagonals, and the X-only and Y-only variants used when snapping to diagonal wires. Also gives the nearest point on the line.

params.Mode: 0 normal, 1 measure along X only, 2 measure along Y only
params.Nearest: set to the closest point on the segment

LineDistance.text: Distance from a point to a line segment, with the nearest point.

params.Nearest: set to the closest point on the segment

LineDistanceX.text: Like LineDistance but measured horizontally (used to snap to diagonal wires).

LineDistanceY.text: Like LineDistance but measured vertically (used to snap to diagonal wires).

RIsInside.text: Recursive test of whether a segment passes through a rectangle (CLineUtils::IsInside): classifies both ends by area and, when undecided, splits the segment in two.
RIsInside.returns: True if the segment crosses or touches the rectangle

LineIsInside.text: Whether a segment touches a rectangle; a degenerate rectangle (one point) is a click test within the point-on-line distance.

LineIsPointOnLine.text: Whether a point lies on a segment (within the point-on-line distance, 0.01) and how far along it, from 0 at A to 1 at B.
LineIsPointOnLine.returns: True if the point is on the segment

params.DistanceAlong: set to the fraction along the segment

LinePointAt.text: The point a fraction of the way along a segment (clamped to the ends).

LineIsDiagonal.text: Whether a segment is neither horizontal nor vertical.

SnapToGrid.text: Rounds a coordinate to the nearest grid line (halves round up); unchanged when snapping is off or the grid is 0. TinyCAD's Transform::Snap.

RotatePointAbout.text: Rotates or mirrors a point about a centre point: 2 and 3 turn it left and right, 4 mirrors left to right, and so on for the codes TinyCAD uses.

DoRotateDir.text: The new direction of a pin, power symbol or label after a rotation or mirror (table taken from TinyCAD).
DoRotateDir.returns: the new direction 0-3 (up, down, left, right)

DoRotateMethod.text: The new rotation / mirror state (0-7) of a placed symbol after a further rotation or mirror (table taken from TinyCAD).

TTransform.Create.text: Creates a transform with no origin offset, zoom 1 and no scaling, as TinyCAD's Transform does.

TTransform.Round.text: Rounds to the nearest integer, halves away from zero, as the C++ code does.

TTransform.DoubleScale.text: Multiplies a length by the zoom factor without rounding.

TTransform.ScaleX.text: Design x to pixel x: applies the symbol scaling, subtracts the origin, multiplies by the zoom and adds the pixel offset.

TTransform.ScaleY.text: Design y to pixel y (flipped when the y axis points up, as inside a symbol view).

TTransform.SetZoomFactor.text: Sets the zoom (pixels per design unit).

TTransform.GetOrigin.text: The design point at the top left of the view.

TTransform.GetScaledOrigin.text: The origin after the symbol scaling is applied.

TTransform.GetRotMir.text: The current rotation / mirror state (0-7) set up by SetTRM.

TTransform.GetIsYUp.text: Whether y is currently inverted (true while drawing a symbol view).

TTransform.SetScaling.text: Sets the x and y scaling of a placed symbol, swapped when the symbol is rotated a quarter turn.

TTransform.GetScaling.text: Reads the current x and y scaling the way SetScaling stored it.

TTransform.SetTRM.text: Starts drawing inside a placed symbol: sets translation, rotation and mirror from the symbol's position, size and state, and returns the previous origin to restore with EndTRM.

TTransform.EndTRM.text: Ends drawing inside a symbol by restoring the previous origin and clearing the rotation.

TTransform.ScaleDist.text: A length in design units as whole pixels.

TTransform.RotateDir.text: A direction after the current rotation / mirror, so pins and text keep reading correctly inside a rotated symbol.

TTransform.DeScale@double.text: A length in pixels to design units.

TTransform.DeScaleSnapped.text: Pixel position to design point, snapped to the grid.

RoundHalfUp.text: Rounds halves up (toward positive infinity), unlike Pascal's Round which rounds halves to even.

TApproxTextMetrics.Create.text: Creates the default text measurer, which approximates Windows' Arial measuring: character advance widths, the 5x "datum" scale and per-glyph rounding.

TApproxTextMetrics.TextExtent.text: Measures text in a font: width from per-character advances (scaled by the font height and any requested width) and height from the font height. An empty string measures 0 by 0, as GDI does. Geometry that depends on text size (reference points, label boxes) uses this.
TApproxTextMetrics.TextExtent.returns: width and height in design units

TFixedTextMetrics.CreateWith.text: Creates a test measurer where every character has the same width and every line the same height.

TFixedTextMetrics.TextExtent.text: Width is characters times the fixed width; height is the fixed height. Used so tests get exact, predictable results.
